notes: Ludum Dare 50 Compo (https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/50/thatslife; https://maxi1324.itch.io/thats-life) by Maxi1324. Complete Unity 2020.3.19f1 project with playable Start, Main, and EndScreen scenes in EditorBuildSettings (drive a car around a planet, smash CO2 factories, pick up speed orbs). MIT at repo-root LICENSE (Copyright 2022 Maxi1324). Author states all art, code, and sound were self-made in 48 hours (Unity, Blender, Krita, Audacity, Bosca Ceoil). Official Unity packages only (URP 10.6.0, TextMesh Pro 3.0.6, VFX Graph 10.6.0, Timeline, uGUI). Third-party: JimmyCushnie/Noisy-Nodes (WTFPL) at Assets/Librarys/Noisy-Nodes-master, including keijiro/NoiseShader wrapping webgl-noise (MIT) and K.jpg simplex (Unlicense). Liberation Sans (OFL-1.1) retained as the TMP default font. Omitted TextMesh Pro EmojiOne sample sprites and Examples & Extras (uncertain demo fonts); cleared TMP Settings default sprite asset that pointed at the omitted EmojiOne asset. No DOTween, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no Asset Store packages, no LFS, no DLL. ~86M src snapshot.
